name: What is a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) in real estate?

mainEntity.name: What is a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) in real estate?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) is an evaluation that provides an estimated value of a property by comparing it to similar properties that have recently sold, are currently on the market, or have failed to sell in the same area. This analysis helps sellers set a competitive listing price and buyers make informed offers. Kelby Contreras leverages current market data from Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, and Orange Counties to provide accurate and localized insights.
acceptedAnswer.description: A CMA estimates a property's value by comparing it to similar, recently sold or listed properties in the same area.
